{{Top|leg}}
'''Repair grids''' were used in the repairing of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Pellezara station]], a stopover point for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]], featured repair grids.
